fields.name: duration
fields.title: Duration
fields.description: The duration of the generated video in seconds, up to 10 seconds. Set to 'auto' to let the model choose the duration automatically.

fields.name: resolution
fields.title: Resolution
fields.description: The resolution of the generated video.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.title: Aspect Ratio
fields.description: The aspect ratio of the generated video. If 'auto', the aspect ratio will be determined automatically based on the input image.

fields.name: fps
fields.title: Frames per Second
fields.description: The frames per second of the generated video.

fields.name: generate_audio
fields.title: Generate Audio
fields.description: Whether to generate audio for the generated video

fields.name: camera_motion
fields.title: Camera Motion
fields.description: Optional camera motion applied to the generated video.
